ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, we will explore how social behaviors are mediated by computational systems. Focusing on a combination of sociological foundations and recent advances in HCI, NLP, and human-centered AI, we will learn to understand, build, and evaluate social computing systems. Through this course, students will read and critique high-impact research papers, lead and engage in class discussions, provide and receive constructive peer-feedback, and execute a new research project for their final paper.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
